text:
prashant: Hey team — we need a quota bump in GCP europe-south1 for A2 GPUs (specifically requesting 8x a2-highgpu-1g per region initially, target pool 32 GPUs). Customer demo is next Friday, so we need provisioning + IP/forwarding-rule quota increase. Any volunteer to drive the support case?

alex: I can drive. do we have a billing account/commit number to attach? also need expected usage profile (vCPU, GPUs by day/week).

maria: Prashant — pls drop the forecast numbers here and a short business justification. GCP will want QTY + timeline + revenue impact.

prashant: Forecast: Week1 (demo): 8 GPUs for 2 days. Week2: 16 GPUs steady. Month+ : 32 GPUs steady for load testing. Cost center: INFRA-REDWOOD-PLG. Customer: Acme AI (PO will follow).

alex: Opening case now. Case created: 2468120031. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/2468120031 (internal only). Putting Tier2 notes.

devops-bot: [auto] New support case 2468120031 created by alex for project redwood-prod-eu. Status: Open.

alex: GCP replied asking for justification and contact details. I pasted the forecast above and added: ```We require a temporary increase to provision a dedicated inference pool for an enterprise POC. Demo on YYYY-MM-DD. Expected 32 A2 GPUs for load validation. This is non-production POC and will move to reserved capacity if successful. Contact: prashant@redwood.ai, +1-555-0199.```

cloud-support: Hi all — thanks for the details. Case 2468120031 has been routed to Capacity Planning. They asked for the exact machine family (a2-highgpu-1g) and whether you need internal load balancer forwarding rules and regional IP addresses. Also they flagged potential soft quota for "static external IPv4 addresses" in europe-south1.

sophie: We will need 4 static external IPv4 addresses and 2 internal LB forwarding rules to expose the demo. Add that to the case.

alex: Updated case with IP + LB request. Also attached traffic profile: 80 RPS at peak, short-lived sessions.

cloud-support: Update: Capacity Planning asked for a short justification doc and business contact verification. They've created a sub-case: 2468120031-ESC. Estimated response time 48-72 hours if no escalation.

prashant: Demo deadline is <72 hours, can we escalate to expedited review? This is a paid customer POC and we risk losing the slot.

maria: To escalate we need CSM or sales approval note. Who can sign off?

prashant: CSM is julie.csm@redwood.ai — I'll ping her now.

alex: Added note to case: "CSM Julie approved expedited review for customer Acme AI demo on YYYY-MM-DD. Phone: +1-555-0321." Also included cost center INFRA-REDWOOD-PLG.

ticket-bot: [auto] Case 2468120031 status changed to "Escalated to Capacity Ops (Priority: High)". ETA update: 24-36 hours.

cloud-support: Quick note from Capacity Ops: They need confirmation of billing account ownership (console project owner) and a signed PO or a statement of intent. If you don't have a PO, a short email from sales/CSM confirming demo & potential spend works.

maria: I drafted a 2-line email for CSM to send. Alex, do you want to paste it to the case?

alex: Pasting now: "Confirming Acme AI demo on YYYY-MM-DD. We will move to Reserved capacity if POC successful. Anticipated spend $25k/month. Approving expedited capacity bump for demo. — Julie (CSM)"

cloud-support: Received. Capacity Ops acknowledged and have begun provisioning capacity reservations for a temporary quota bump. They also noted they might convert some requests into per-project soft-limits, so we should be ready to request sustained reservations.

prashant: Any ask from network team? LB/Firewall changes?

sophie: Need a firewall rule to allow TCP 443 from Acme IP ranges, I'll open an infra ticket for that and tag netops. Will share firewall rule snippet: ``gcloud compute firewall-rules create demo-acme --network default --allow tcp:443 --source-ranges 198.51.100.0/24``

alex: Cloud support updated case: provisioning started. Partial approval for 8 GPUs immediate, remaining 24 under review. They requested an approximate schedule for scaling (we gave Week2/Month+ above).

cloud-support: Also flag: forwarding-rule quota in europe-south1 is 50 per project by default; current usage is 47. They can increase but may ask for consolidation.

maria: Can we reuse existing forwarding rules? Alex, can you inventory current forwarding rules and attempt consolidation?

alex: On it. Quick audit shows 3 unused forwarding rules older than 90 days — I'll clean up and update case.

devops-bot: [auto] Cleanup job scheduled: delete-unused-forwarding-rules (dry-run).

alex: Cleaned up 3 unused rules; updated case and requested remaining 24 GPU quota to be provisioned ASAP.

cloud-support: Capacity Ops follow-up: Case 2468120031-ESC now shows "Provisioning: Partial (8/32) - Remaining queued". They expect to allocate another 12 within 12 hours, remainder by EOD tomorrow if no further blockers. They asked to confirm that billing account INFRA-REDWOOD-PLG has sufficient quota/limits for sustained reservations.

prashant: Confirmed — billing account ok. Can someone monitor and confirm once the additional GPUs are up? I'll take post-deploy verification.

maria: I'll watch the ticket and ping Capacity Ops in 6 hours. If anything stalls, escalate to Customer Desk lead.

alex: Noted. Devops will also run a smoke test when GPUs appear. Smoke test: run the model load test script and check kernel counts + nvml visibility. Sample command: ```python tests/load_test.py --model gpt-lt --gpus 8 --duration 600```

prashant: Thanks all. Please @here if provisioning moves to 24+ GPUs so I can re-schedule demo if needed.

ticket-bot: [auto] Last update: Case 2468120031 — Provisioning in progress. Logs attached.

cloud-support: Final note for today — they provisioned another 12 GPUs (now 20 of 32). Remaining 12 queued. Will update when fully provisioned or if IP quotas block.

alex: :thumbsup:
